description: This file defines the interface for the Zigbee Level Control Cluster, including structure definitions, function prototypes for creating clusters, getting/setting levels, configuring binding and reporting, and retrieving level information as strings. It serves as a header for managing Zigbee level control functionalities within the device SDK.
external_methods: bool levelControlClusterGetLevel(uint64_t eui64, uint8_t endpointId, uint8_t *level)
bool levelControlClusterSetLevel(uint64_t eui64, uint8_t endpointId, uint8_t level)

methods.name: levelControlClusterCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Level Control Cluster instance with specified callbacks and context.

methods.name: levelControlClusterGetLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current level for a given device identified by EUI64 and endpoint.

methods.name: levelControlClusterSetLevel
methods.description: Sets the level for a specified device and endpoint.

methods.name: levelControlClusterSetBindingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables attribute binding for the device.

methods.name: levelControlClusterSetAttributeReporting
methods.description: Configures attribute reporting for the level on the specified device.

methods.name: levelControlClusterGetLevelString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a given level.

methods.name: levelControlClusterGetLevelFromString
methods.description: Parses a string to obtain the corresponding level value.
